narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate on the landing book-map: a forest half-consumed by fire, yet the glowing living network webbed across it stays lit and unbroken — the single image of a network shrugging off the loss of its pieces, the visual thesis that burning Eywa does not kill her.
subject: A vast Pandoran rainforest seen from a high vantage at night, the right half scorched into a black burn-scar of charred stumps and smoking ground where machines have clear-cut and torched a wide swathe; yet stretched across the entire landscape — over the living trees and straight across the burnt void alike — a fine luminous cyan lattice of glowing thread-like connections still webs from treetop to treetop, the strands over the burn re-knitting around the gap like a net with a hole punched in it that simply closes over.
scene: An aerial-oblique view of a continental forest at night, a sharp diagonal boundary between intact glowing canopy on the left and a fire-blackened clear-cut on the right, the connective web of light spanning both.
camera: A high three-quarter aerial vantage looking down and across the forest, wide enough to hold both the living canopy and the burn-scar in one sweep.
light: Bioluminescent key from the network web itself — cool cyan and teal light tracing the connective strands across the canopy; a low, dying ember-amber glow smouldering in the burn-scar as the only warm accent; deep indigo night above.
palette: Void-indigo and deep teal-indigo base, dominant Pandora cyan and living teal in the glowing web, scarce ember-amber confined to the smouldering burn, the charred ground near-black.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, observed-from-life confidence, luminous and atmospheric.
detail_level: Crisp and intricate on the glowing connective web and the boundary where living canopy meets burn-scar; the far forest dissolving into haze.
composition: Diagonal division of the frame between lit forest and dark burn, the luminous web arcing across the seam, generous hazy negative space toward the horizon for the plate to breathe.
consistency_notes: Na'vi absent; a landscape plate. Cool Pandora palette with from-within bioluminescent key; warm reserved strictly for the dying fire. The establishing 'the net survives the wound' mood that anchors the whole chapter.
